# [0.34.0](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.33.11...v0.34.0) (2026-11-23)


### Bug Fixes

* **capture:** a declared gate refuses only what its declaration states ([83bf979](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/83bf979dadcf23a4fcd2ce35e63ba29e9eb71dcd))
* **capture:** a figure is one token, in the claims and in the match ([141e8a9](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/141e8a906b044b8b996a2f078cbf2d78bc9c11cb))
* **capture:** a figure is vouched by the passage the match covered ([5845da6](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/5845da673bed70840071d45e3a4b7847e7d56174))
* **capture:** a gate refusal needs the operands as a run, not as a word bag ([d3f7b5d](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/d3f7b5df34dc29c332388d989e536c9412442749))
* **capture:** a refusal may only claim figures the tree states as whole tokens ([07bdc61](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/07bdc614d47c8f8cff4a0ac9153c431bc7b7b225))
* **capture:** a refusal needs the claims contiguous in the tree, not merely present ([23f4abb](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/23f4abb9f7431e0b8a8e38a2bb8ae6e86a014e0a))
* **capture:** a step-kind declaration vouches for its own step only ([33c0dcd](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/33c0dcd0af3944b6e0f97a085747dadf9469d532))
* **capture:** each command span vouches with its own declaration ([bf11254](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/bf1125490543cb781eca7fb9efd2e7b122db7e8f))


### Features

* **capture:** refuse restatable candidates, spend capture on unavailable facts ([fa9bade](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/fa9bade100f78537ca501fc903c7aded8b0861d3))

* **dedupe:** decide whether a recall row rides before changing any slot ([75b6e30](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/75b6e30c8c5f4357ae5974306ccd1dfcb7cbd679))
* **dedupe:** vacate the copy a recall row beat, instead of returning it twice ([a9c0b7d](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/a9c0b7daad0040d07d5ae17301734310a386b5be))
